summary.claim_boundary: Eight-seed development audit comparing online moving-kernel and fixed-source-chart natural paths at Fisher step radii 0.04 and 0.02. It measures response-retraction Fisher length, tangent residual, action convergence, and step-size scaling at one matched 20% endpoint. No post-hoc lambda-weighted composite action is tested. Newton response retraction approximates finite constrained motion. This is not a 16-seed confirmation, exact continuum horizontal lift, arbitrary-path result, GPT-2 transfer, stationarity theorem, or global variational law.
